Ejemplo 6: Análisis de respuestas SMTP de varias líneas (`smtp parse response`)\n\nEn este ejemplo práctico exploramos de forma exhaustiva cómo se comporta `mail` en este bloque funcional, incluyendo entradas estándar, combinaciones de parámetros y valores frontera:\n\n```ridgun\nfn :: test parse response => ()\n      test parse response =\n        c1, l1, r1 = smtp parse response \"250-mx.example.org\\r\\n250-STARTTLS\\r\\n250 8BITMIME\\r\\nNEXT\"\n        assert eq c1 250 -> ()\n        assert eq (c str list len l1 0) 3 -> ()\n        assert str eq (c nth str l1 1) \"STARTTLS\" \"multi-line reply text\" -> ()\n        assert str eq r1 \"NEXT\" \"remaining input\" -> ()\n        c2, _, _ = smtp parse response \"250-partial\\r\\n\"\n        assert eq c2 (0 - 1) -> ()\n        c3, _, _ = smtp parse response \"hello\\r\\n\"\n        assert eq c3 (0 - 2) -> ()\n        c4, l4, _ = smtp parse response \"220\\r\\n\"\n        assert eq c4 220 -> ()\n        assert str eq (c nth str l4 0) \"\" \"bare code\" -> ()\n```\n\n### 38.3.7. Ejemplo 7: Un servidor SMTP local: STARTTLS antes de AUTH, TLS implícito, destinatarios rechazados y errores de autenticación\n\nEn este ejemplo práctico exploramos de forma exhaustiva cómo se comporta `mail` en este bloque funcional, incluyendo entradas estándar, combinaciones de parámetros y valores frontera:\n\n```ridgun\nfn :: test smtp local String => ()\n      test smtp local dir    =\n        p   = base port\n        r1  = run local dir p \"starttls\" (client cfg dir p) (sample msg) False\n        assert true (smtp is ok r1) (\"STARTTLS + AUTH PLAIN: \" + (smtp error kind r1) + \" \" + (smtp error reason r1)) -> ()\n        log1 = smtp log dir p\n        assert true ((index of log1 \"C: STARTTLS\") >= 0 and (index of log1 \"TLS: established\") > (index of log1 \"C: STARTTLS\")) \"STARTTLS before TLS\" -> ()\n        assert true ((index of log1 \"C: AUTH PLAIN\") > (index of log1 \"TLS: established\")) \"AUTH only after TLS\" -> ()\n        assert true (str contains log1 \"C: MAIL FROM:\") \"envelope sender\" -> ()\n        assert true (str contains log1 \"C: RCPT TO:\") \"first recipient\" -> ()\n        assert true (str contains log1 \"C: RCPT TO:\") \"second recipient\" -> ()\n        assert true (str contains log1 \"\\r\\n..hidden line\\r\\n\") \"DATA is dot-stuffed on the wire\" -> ()\n        assert true (str contains log1 \"C: QUIT\") \"QUIT\" -> ()\n\n        r2  = run local dir (p + 1) \"nostarttls\" (client cfg dir (p + 1)) (sample msg) False\n        assert str eq (smtp error kind r2) \"SmtpTlsError\" \"no STARTTLS offered -> SmtpTlsError\" -> ()\n        log2 = smtp log dir (p + 1)\n        assert false (str contains log2 \"AUTH\") \"credentials never sent in cleartext\" -> ()\n        assert false (str contains log2 \"MAIL FROM\") \"no cleartext transaction\" -> ()\n\n        r3  = run local dir (p + 2) \"implicit\" (smtp with auth (client cfg dir (p + 2)) \"login\") (sample msg) True\n        assert true (smtp is ok r3) (\"implicit TLS + AUTH LOGIN: \" + (smtp error kind r3) + \" \" + (smtp error reason r3)) -> ()\n        assert true (str contains (smtp log dir (p + 2)) \"C: AUTH LOGIN\") \"AUTH LOGIN used\" -> ()\n\n        r4  = run local dir (p + 3) \"badauth\" (client cfg dir (p + 3)) (sample msg) False\n        assert str eq (smtp error kind r4) \"SmtpAuthError\" \"535 -> SmtpAuthError\" -> ()\n        assert true (str starts with (smtp error reason r4) \"535\") \"auth error carries the code\" -> ()\n        assert false (smtp is retryable r4) \"auth errors are not retryable\" -> ()\n\n        r5  = run local dir (p + 4) \"starttls\" (client cfg dir (p + 4)) (mail add to (sample msg) \"reject-me@example.org\") False\n        assert str eq (smtp error kind r5) \"SmtpRejectedRecipient\" \"550 on RCPT -> SmtpRejectedRecipient\" -> ()\n\n        r6  = run local dir (p + 5) \"tempfail\" (client cfg dir (p + 5)) (sample msg) False\n        assert str eq (smtp error kind r6) \"SmtpTemporaryError\" \"451 -> SmtpTemporaryError\" -> ()\n        assert true (smtp is retryable r6) \"4xx is retryable\" -> ()\n\n        bad_roots = smtp with tls (client cfg dir (p + 6)) (tls with root pem (tls defaults) (read file (dir + \"/other.pem\")))\n        r7  = run local dir (p + 6) \"starttls\" bad_roots (sample msg) False\n        assert str eq (smtp error kind r7) \"SmtpTlsError\" \"untrusted server certificate -> SmtpTlsError\" -> ()\n        assert false (str contains (smtp log dir (p + 6)) \"AUTH\") \"no credentials after a failed handshake\" -> ()\n\n        r8  = smtp send (client cfg dir (p + 7)) (sample msg with subject_line = \"x\\r\\nBcc: e@example.org\")\n        assert str eq (smtp error kind r8) \"SmtpInvalidMessage\" \"invalid message is rejected before connecting\" -> ()\n        r9  = smtp send (client cfg dir 1) (sample msg)\n        assert str eq (smtp error kind r9) \"SmtpConnectionError\" \"refused connection -> SmtpConnectionError\" -> ()\n        assert true (smtp is retryable r9) \"connection errors are retryable\" -> ()\n```\n\n### 38.3.8. Ejemplo 8: Servidores de envío en vivo en los puertos 587 y 465\n\nEn este ejemplo práctico exploramos de forma exhaustiva cómo se comporta `mail` en este bloque funcional, incluyendo entradas estándar, combinaciones de parámetros y valores frontera:\n\n```ridgun\nfn :: test smtp live => ()\n      test smtp live =\n        live smtp \"smtp.gmail.com\" 587 False\n        live smtp \"smtp.gmail.com\" 465 True\n```\n\n---\n\n## 38.4. Bajo el capó: cómo está construida `mail` en Ridgun puro (`src/main/ridgun/lib/mail.ridgun`)\n\nUna de las mayores ventajas de `ridgun-libs` es que **no hay cajas negras en C**. Puedes abrir `src/main/ridgun/lib/mail.ridgun` y leer exactamente cómo está implementada cada operación usando *pattern matching*, árboles de guardas `|` / `|.` y recursión de cola (TCO). Veamos las piezas clave de su implementación real:\n\n### 38.4.1. Implementación interna: Message construction (API-MAIL-001)\n\nFíjate en cómo `mail.ridgun` estructura las firmas `fn :: ... => ...` primero y resuelve cada caso mediante ecuaciones alineadas y llamadas de cola:\n\n```ridgun\nfn :: mail message String String String String => MailMessage\n      mail message from_a to_a   subject text   =  MailMessage from_a [to_a] \"\" subject text \"\" \"\" 0\n\nfn :: mail with html MailMessage String => MailMessage\n      mail with html msg         html   =  msg with html_body = html\n\nfn :: mail with reply to MailMessage String => MailMessage\n      mail with reply to msg         addr   =  msg with reply_to_addr = addr\n\nfn :: mail add to MailMessage String => MailMessage\n      mail add to msg         addr   =  msg with to_addrs = (to_addrs msg) :: [addr]\n\nfn :: mail with to MailMessage [String] => MailMessage\n      mail with to msg         addrs    =  msg with to_addrs = addrs\n\nfn :: mail with date MailMessage Int => MailMessage\n      mail with date msg         sec =  msg with date_sec = sec\n\nfn :: mail with message id MailMessage String => MailMessage\n      mail with message id msg         mid    =  msg with message_id = mid\n```\n\n### 38.4.2. Implementación interna: Address validation (RFC 5321 §4.1.2 Mailbox = Dot-string \"@\" Domain)\n\nFíjate en cómo `mail.ridgun` estructura las firmas `fn :: ... => ...` primero y resuelve cada caso mediante ecuaciones alineadas y llamadas de cola:\n\n```ridgun\nfn :: m is atext Int => Bool\n      m is atext c   =\n        (c >= 97 and c <= 122) or (c >= 65 and c <= 90) or (c >= 48 and c <= 57) or c == 33 or (c >= 35 and c <= 39) or c == 42 or c == 43 or c == 45 or c == 47 or c == 61 or c == 63 or (c >= 94 and c <= 96) or (c >= 123 and c <= 126)\n\nfn :: m valid local String Int Int Bool => Bool\n      m valid local s      idx slen prev_dot =\n        | idx >= slen              = not prev_dot\n        | (m u8 s idx) == 46       = (not prev_dot) and idx > 0 and (m valid local s (idx + 1) slen True)\n        | m is atext (m u8 s idx)  = m valid local s (idx + 1) slen False\n        | otherwise                = False\n\nfn :: m is ld Int => Bool\n      m is ld c   =  (c >= 97 and c <= 122) or (c >= 65 and c <= 90) or (c >= 48 and c <= 57)\n\n-- Domain = sub-domain *(\".\" sub-domain); sub-domain = Let-dig [Ldh-str] (max 63 per label).\nfn :: m valid domain String Int Int Int => Bool\n      m valid domain s      idx slen label_len =\n        | idx >= slen =\n          label_len > 0 and (m is ld (m u8 s (slen - 1)))\n        | (m u8 s idx) == 46 =\n          label_len > 0 and (m is ld (m u8 s (idx - 1))) and (m valid domain s (idx + 1) slen 0)\n        | label_len == 0 and not (m is ld (m u8 s idx)) = False\n        | (m is ld (m u8 s idx)) or (m u8 s idx) == 45  =\n          label_len < 63 and (m valid domain s (idx + 1) slen (label_len + 1))\n        | otherwise = False\n\nfn :: mail valid address String => Bool\n      mail valid address addr   =\n        at  = m last index of addr 64 ((str len addr) - 1)\n        lp  = str slice addr 0 at\n        dom = tls rest addr (at + 1)\n        res =\n          | (str len addr) > 254 or at <= 0 or at > 64       = False\n          | (str len dom) == 0 or (str len dom) > 253        = False\n          | otherwise = (m valid local lp 0 (str len lp) False) and (m valid domain dom 0 (str len dom) 0)\n        res\n\nfn :: m trim String => String\n      m trim s      =  c trim s\n\n-- \"Name \" -> (name, addr); a bare address -> (\"\", addr).\nfn :: mail split mailbox String => String String\n      mail split mailbox s      =\n        t   = m trim s\n        lt  = m index of t 60 0 (str len t)\n        res =\n          | lt >= 0 and (str len t) > 0 and (m u8 t ((str len t) - 1)) == 62 =\n            (m unquote (m trim (str slice t 0 lt)), m trim (str slice t (lt + 1) ((str len t) - 1)))\n          | otherwise = (\"\", t)\n        res\n\nfn :: m unquote String => String\n      m unquote s      =\n        | (str len s) >= 2 and (m u8 s 0) == 34 and (m u8 s ((str len s) - 1)) == 34 = str slice s 1 ((str len s) - 1)\n        | otherwise                                                                  = s\n\nfn :: mail address of String => String\n      mail address of s      =\n        name, addr = mail split mailbox s\n        addr\n\nfn :: m domain of String => String\n      m domain of addr   =  tls rest addr ((m last index of addr 64 ((str len addr) - 1)) + 1)\n\nfn :: m all valid [String] => Bool\n      m all valid []       =  True\n      m all valid (a:rest) =  (mail valid address (mail address of a)) and (m all valid rest)\n\nfn :: m any crlf [String] => Bool\n      m any crlf []       =  False\n      m any crlf (a:rest) =  (m has crlf a) or (m any crlf rest)\n\nfn :: m no addrs [String] => Bool\n      m no addrs []    =  True\n      m no addrs (_:_) =  False\n```\n\n### 38.4.3. Implementación interna: Bodies: quoted-printable (RFC 2045 §6.7) and dot-stuffing\n\nFíjate en cómo `mail.ridgun` estructura las firmas `fn :: ... => ...` primero y resuelve cada caso mediante ecuaciones alineadas y llamadas de cola:\n\n```ridgun\nfn :: m qp token String Int Int => String\n      m qp token s      idx slen =\n        | (m u8 s idx) == 61                                          = \"=3D\"\n        | ((m u8 s idx) == 32 or (m u8 s idx) == 9) and idx == (slen - 1) = \"=\" + (m upper hex (m u8 s idx))\n        | (m u8 s idx) == 32 or (m u8 s idx) == 9                     = str slice s idx (idx + 1)\n        | (m u8 s idx) >= 33 and (m u8 s idx) <= 126                  = str slice s idx (idx + 1)\n        | otherwise                                                   = \"=\" + (m upper hex (m u8 s idx))\n\n-- Encode one source line into output lines of <= 76 chars using \"=\" soft breaks.\nfn :: m qp line String Int Int String [String] => [String]\n      m qp line s      idx slen cur    acc      =\n        | idx >= slen = [cur] :: acc\n        | otherwise   =\n          tok = m qp token s idx slen\n          res =\n            | (str len cur) + (str len tok) > 75 = m qp line s (idx + 1) slen tok ([cur + \"=\"] :: acc)\n            | otherwise                          = m qp line s (idx + 1) slen (cur + tok) acc\n          res\n\nfn :: m qp lines [String] [String] => [String]\n      m qp lines []       acc =  tls reverse acc []\n      m qp lines (l:rest) acc =  m qp lines rest (m qp line l 0 (str len l) \"\" acc)\n\nfn :: mail qp encode String => String\n      mail qp encode body   =  m join sep (m qp lines (m split lines body) []) \"\\r\\n\"\n\nfn :: m stuff lines [String] [String] => [String]\n      m stuff lines []       acc =  tls reverse acc []\n      m stuff lines (l:rest) acc =\n        | (str len l) > 0 and (m u8 l 0) == 46 = m stuff lines rest ([\".\" + l] :: acc)\n        | otherwise                           = m stuff lines rest ([l] :: acc)\n\n-- Normalise line endings to CRLF and prefix \".\" to lines that start with \".\" (RFC 5321 §4.5.2).\nfn :: smtp dot stuff String => String\n      smtp dot stuff data   =  m join sep (m stuff lines (m split lines data) []) \"\\r\\n\"\n```\n\n### 38.4.4. Implementación interna: Rendering (FR-MAIL-001 AC1)\n\nFíjate en cómo `mail.ridgun` estructura las firmas `fn :: ... => ...` primero y resuelve cada caso mediante ecuaciones alineadas y llamadas de cola:\n\n```ridgun\nfn :: m hex random Int => String\n      m hex random n   =  bytes to hex str (tls random \"m\" n)\n\nfn :: m header String String => String\n      m header name  value  =  name + \": \" + value + \"\\r\\n\"\n\nfn :: m qp part String String => String\n      m qp part ctype  body   =  (m header \"Content-Type\" (ctype + \"; charset=UTF-8\")) + (m header \"Content-Transfer-Encoding\" \"quoted-printable\") + \"\\r\\n\" + (mail qp encode body) + \"\\r\\n\"\n\nfn :: m body part MailMessage => String\n      m body part msg         =\n        | (html_body msg) == \"\" = m qp part \"text/plain\" (text_body msg)\n        | otherwise             =\n          b = \"=_ridgun_\" + (m hex random 12)\n          (m header \"Content-Type\" (\"multipart/alternative; boundary=\\\"\" + b + \"\\\"\")) + \"\\r\\n\" + \"--\" + b + \"\\r\\n\" + (m qp part \"text/plain\" (text_body msg)) + \"--\" + b + \"\\r\\n\" + (m qp part \"text/html\" (html_body msg)) + \"--\" + b + \"--\\r\\n\"\n\nfn :: m message id MailMessage => String\n      m message id msg         =\n        | (message_id msg) == \"\"                                       = \"<\" + (m hex random 16) + \"@\" + (m domain of (mail address of (from_addr msg))) + \">\"\n        | str starts with (message_id msg) \"<\"                         = message_id msg\n        | otherwise                                                    = \"<\" + (message_id msg) + \">\"\n\nfn :: m date of MailMessage => Int\n      m date of msg         =\n        | (date_sec msg) > 0 = date_sec msg\n        | otherwise          = (sys wall time ms) / 1000\n\nfn :: m render ok MailMessage => String\n      m render ok msg         =\n        reply =\n          | (reply_to_addr msg) == \"\" = \"\"\n          | otherwise                 = m header \"Reply-To\" (m format mailbox (reply_to_addr msg))\n        heads = (m header \"From\" (m format mailbox (from_addr msg))) + (m header \"To\" (m join sep (m format list (to_addrs msg) []) \", \")) + reply + (m header \"Subject\" (mail encode rfc2047 (subject_line msg))) + (m header \"Date\" (mail format date (m date of msg))) + (m header \"Message-ID\" (m message id msg)) + (m header \"MIME-Version\" \"1.0\")\n        smtp dot stuff (heads + (m body part msg))\n\n-- Render the message as sent after DATA (CRLF, quoted-printable, dot-stuffed).\nfn :: mail render MailMessage => MailResult\n      mail render msg         =\n        | m has crlf (from_addr msg)                    = MailErr \"header injection: CR or LF in From\"\n        | m any crlf (to_addrs msg)                     = MailErr \"header injection: CR or LF in To\"\n        | m has crlf (reply_to_addr msg)                = MailErr \"header injection: CR or LF in Reply-To\"\n        | m has crlf (subject_line msg)                 = MailErr \"header injection: CR or LF in Subject\"\n        | m has crlf (message_id msg)                   = MailErr \"header injection: CR or LF in Message-ID\"\n        | not (mail valid address (mail address of (from_addr msg))) = MailErr \"invalid From address\"\n        | m no addrs (to_addrs msg)                     = MailErr \"no recipients\"\n        | not (m all valid (to_addrs msg))              = MailErr \"invalid To address\"\n        | (reply_to_addr msg) != \"\" and not (mail valid address (mail address of (reply_to_addr msg))) = MailErr \"invalid Reply-To address\"\n        | otherwise                                     = MailOk (m render ok msg)\n\nfn :: mail is ok MailResult => Bool\n      mail is ok (MailOk _)  =  True\n      mail is ok (MailErr _) =  False\n\nfn :: mail unwrap MailResult => String\n      mail unwrap (MailOk s)  =  s\n      mail unwrap (MailErr _) =  \"\"\n\nfn :: mail error MailResult => String\n      mail error (MailOk _)  =  \"\"\n      mail error (MailErr e) =  e\n```\n\n---\n\n## 38.5. Garantías algorítmicas, memoria `RMM1`/`RMM2` y las 5 Reglas de Oro de `mail`\n\n- **Garantía algorítmica y de seguridad**: `mail render` rechaza cualquier valor de cabecera que contenga CR o LF, de modo que la entrada del usuario no puede añadir cabeceras, y `smtp send` nunca continúa en claro: sin TLS implícito el servidor debe ofrecer STARTTLS, y las credenciales se envían solo después del handshake.\n- **Complejidad de pila $O(1)$ con TCO**: Todos los bucles recursivos en `src/main/ridgun/lib/mail.ridgun` están en posición de cola, por lo que `ridgunc` los compila a saltos nativos sin crecimiento de pila.\n- **Memoria determinista (`RMM1`/`RMM2`)**: Cero pausas de recolector de basura; todas las estructuras intermedias se liberan de forma determinista al salir del ámbito.\n- **Verificación continua**: Probada exhaustivamente con `stable check` y la suite automatizada `src/test/ridgun/test mail.ridgun`.\n\n### Las 5 Reglas de Oro al programar con `mail`\n\n1. **Declara `import mail` al inicio del archivo** y llama a sus funciones con espacios, tal como están declaradas, para que tu código se lea como prosa.\n2. **Alinea tus tuberías de datos con `=`**: encadena las llamadas a `mail` en pasos con nombre propio y deja que `stable format` alinee las columnas.\n3. **Aprovecha las funciones totales de `mail` en tus guardas `|`**: comprueba los valores de retorno o desenvuelve los ADTs con *pattern matching* en lugar de asumir que la entrada externa siempre es válida.\n4. **Evita copiar grandes estructuras si solo necesitas consultar un campo**: recuerda que en `RMM2` los argumentos de entrada no incrementan ni decrementan contadores (`+0` / `-0`).\n5. **Combina `mail` con `test` (`import test`)**: escribe siempre aserciones con `assert equals` o `assert true` para fijar los invariantes de tu dominio.\n\n---\n\n¡Has completado el recorrido por las **38 libs estándar de `ridgun-libs`**!\n"}];
    const UI_STRINGS = {"copy_label": "Copiar", "copied_label": "¡Copiado!", "prev_label": "← Capítulo anterior", "next_label": "Siguiente capítulo →", "search_hits_label": "Resultados para", "search_empty_label": "No se encontraron coincidencias para"};
    let currentIdx = 0;

    function escapeHtml(s) {
      return s.replace(/&/g, "&").replace(//g, ">");
    }

    function highlightSegment(seg) {
      let html = escapeHtml(seg);
      html = html.replace(/("([^"\\]|\\.)*"|'[^']*')/g, '$1');
      html = html.replace(/\b(fn|op|type|import|module|expand|mut|otherwise|with|region|timeout|do|global|context|shared|atomic|hardware|echo|and|or|xor|not|agent|send|to|receive|from|try|stop|in|limit|map|filter|fold)\b/g, '$1');
      html = html.replace(/\b(Int|Real|String|Char|Bool|U64|Tensor|Option|Result|Some|None|Ok|Err|OutOfMemory|Timeout|True|False|[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\b/g, '$1');
      html = html.replace(/(::|=>|->|<-|\|\|\.|\|\||\|\.)/g, '$1');
      html = html.replace(/\b(0x[0-9a-fA-F_]+|[0-9][0-9_]*(_KB|_MB|_GB)?(\.[0-9]+)?)\b/g, '$1');
      return html;
    }

    function scanTopTokens(s) {
      const toks = [];
      let i = 0, n = s.length;
      while (i < n) {
        while (i < n && (s[i] === " " || s[i] === "\t" || s[i] === "\r")) i++;
        if (i >= n) break;
        const start = i;
        if (s[i] === '"' || s[i] === "'") {
          const q = s[i++];
          while (i < n && s[i] !== q) { if (s[i] === "\\") i++; i++; }
          if (i < n) i++;
        } else if (s[i] === "(" || s[i] === "[") {
          let depth = 1; i++;
          while (i < n && depth > 0) {
            if (s[i] === '"' || s[i] === "'") {
              const q = s[i++];
              while (i < n && s[i] !== q) { if (s[i] === "\\") i++; i++; }
            } else if (s[i] === "(" || s[i] === "[") depth++;
            else if (s[i] === ")" || s[i] === "]") depth--;
            i++;
          }
        } else {
          let depth = 0;
          while (i < n && (depth > 0 || (s[i] !== " " && s[i] !== "\t" && s[i] !== "\r"))) {
            if (s[i] === "(" || s[i] === "[") depth++;
            else if (s[i] === ")" || s[i] === "]") depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
            i++;
          }
        }
        toks.push({ text: s.slice(start, i), col: start });
      }
      return toks;
    }

    function isSigTypeTok(t) {
      if (!t) return false;
      const c = t.charCodeAt(0);
      return (c >= 65 && c <= 90) || t[0] === "[" || t[0] === "(";
    }

    function highlightRidgun(code) {
      let curSig = null;
      const nonSigHeads = new Set(["type", "expand", "import", "module", "global", "context", "shared", "hardware"]);
      const kwSet = new Set(["fn","op","type","import","module","expand","mut","otherwise","with","region","timeout","do","global","context","shared","atomic","hardware","echo","and","or","xor","not","agent","send","to","receive","from","try","stop","in","limit","map","filter","fold"]);
      return code.split("\n").map(line => {
        const comIdx = (() => {
          let inD = false, inS = false;
          for (let i = 0; i < line.length - 1; i++) {
            if (line[i] === "\\") { i++; continue; }
            if (line[i] === '"' && !inS) inD = !inD;
            else if (line[i] === "'" && !inD) inS = !inS;
            else if (!inD && !inS && line[i] === "-" && line[i+1] === "-") return i;
          }
          return -1;
        })();
        const codePart = comIdx >= 0 ? line.slice(0, comIdx) : line;
        const comPart = comIdx >= 0 ? line.slice(comIdx) : "";
        const toks = scanTopTokens(codePart);
        let html = "";
        const arrowIdx = toks.findIndex(t => t.text === "=>" || t.text === "->");
        const isPrefixedSig = toks.length >= 3 && (toks[0].text === "fn" || toks[0].text === "op") && toks[1].text === "::" && arrowIdx >= 2;
        const isBareSig = !isPrefixedSig && toks.length >= 2 && !nonSigHeads.has(toks[0].text) && !toks[0].text.startsWith("@") && !toks[0].text.startsWith("|") && arrowIdx >= 1 && toks[arrowIdx].text === "=>" && toks.slice(0, arrowIdx).every(t => isSigTypeTok(t.text) || (!["=","->","<-",":","::"].includes(t.text) && !/^[0-9"'|]/.test(t.text))) && !toks.slice(0, arrowIdx).every(t => isSigTypeTok(t.text));
        if (isPrefixedSig || isBareSig) {
          const startIdx = isPrefixedSig ? 2 : 0;
          const sigLhs = toks.slice(startIdx, arrowIdx).map(t => t.text);
          curSig = sigLhs;
          let pos = isPrefixedSig ? toks[1].col + 2 : 0;
          html = isPrefixedSig ? highlightSegment(codePart.slice(0, pos)) : "";
          for (let k = startIdx; k < arrowIdx; k++) {
            html += escapeHtml(codePart.slice(pos, toks[k].col));
            if (isSigTypeTok(toks[k].text)) {
              html += highlightSegment(toks[k].text);
            } else {
              html += '' + escapeHtml(toks[k].text) + '';
            }
            pos = toks[k].col + toks[k].text.length;
          }
          html += highlightSegment(codePart.slice(pos));
        } else {
          const eqIdx = toks.findIndex(t => t.text === "=");
          const clauseLhs = eqIdx > 0 ? toks.slice(0, eqIdx) : [];
          const matchesSig = curSig && eqIdx === curSig.length && clauseLhs.every((t, idx) => isSigTypeTok(curSig[idx]) || t.text === curSig[idx]);
          const isBareClause = !matchesSig && eqIdx >= 2 && /^[a-z]/.test(clauseLhs[0].text) && !kwSet.has(clauseLhs[0].text) && !(eqIdx === 3 && clauseLhs[1].text === "with");
          if (matchesSig || isBareClause) {
            let pos = 0;
            for (let k = 0; k < eqIdx; k++) {
              html += escapeHtml(codePart.slice(pos, clauseLhs[k].col));
              const isFnSlot = matchesSig ? !isSigTypeTok(curSig[k]) : (k === 0 || kwSet.has(clauseLhs[k].text));
              if (isFnSlot) {
                html += '' + escapeHtml(clauseLhs[k].text) + '';
              } else {
                html += escapeHtml(clauseLhs[k].text);
              }
              pos = clauseLhs[k].col + clauseLhs[k].text.length;
            }
            html += highlightSegment(codePart.slice(pos));
          } else {
            if (toks.length > 0 && nonSigHeads.has(toks[0].text)) curSig = null;
            html = highlightSegment(codePart);
          }
        }
        if (comPart) {
          html += '' + escapeHtml(comPart) + '';
        }
        return html;
      }).join("\n");
    }

    function formatInline(text) {
      let out = escapeHtml(text);
      out = out.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, "$1");
      out = out.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "$1");
      out = out.replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, "$1");
      out = out.replace(/\$O\(([^)]+)\)\$/g, "O($1)");
      out = out.replace(/\$\\rightarrow\$/g, "→");
      return out;
    }

    function renderMarkdown(md) {
      const lines = md.split("\n");
      let html = "";
      let i = 0;
      while (i < lines.length) {
        const line = lines[i];
        if (line.startsWith("```")) {
          const lang = line.slice(3).trim() || "ridgun";
          i++;
          const buf = [];
          while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].startsWith("```")) {
            buf.push(lines[i]);
            i++;
          }
          i++;
          const rawCode = buf.join("\n");
          const bodyHtml = (lang === "ridgun" || lang === "") ? highlightRidgun(rawCode) : escapeHtml(rawCode);
          html += `
    ${escapeHtml(lang)}
    ${bodyHtml}
    `;
          continue;
        }
        if (/^---+$/.test(line.trim())) {
          html += "
    ";
          i++;
          continue;
        }
        if (line.startsWith("# ")) {
          html += `
    ${formatInline(line.slice(2).trim())}
    `;
          i++;
          continue;
        }
        if (line.startsWith("## ")) {
          html += `
    ${formatInline(line.slice(3).trim())}
    `;
          i++;
          continue;
        }
        if (line.startsWith("### ")) {
          html += `
    ${formatInline(line.slice(4).trim())}
    `;
          i++;
          continue;
        }
        if (line.trim().startsWith("|") && i + 1 < lines.length && /^\|[\s:-]+\|/.test(lines[i+1].trim())) {
          const headers = line.trim().slice(1, -1).split("|").map(c => formatInline(c.trim()));
          i += 2;
          const rows = [];
          while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim().startsWith("|")) {
            rows.push(lines[i].trim().slice(1, -1).split("|").map(c => formatInline(c.trim())));
            i++;
          }
          html += '
    ' + headers.map(h => ``).join("") + '' +
                  rows.map(r => '' + r.map(c => ``).join("") + '').join("") + '
    ${h}
    ${c}
    ';
          continue;
        }
        if (line.startsWith(">")) {
          const qLines = [];
          while (i < lines.length && lines[i].startsWith(">")) {
            qLines.push(lines[i].replace(/^>\s?/, ""));
            i++;
          }
          html += `
    ${qLines.map(formatInline).join("
    ")}
    `;
          continue;
        }
        if (/^\s*-\s+/.test(line)) {
          const items = [];
          while (i < lines.length && /^\s*-\s+/.test(lines[i])) {
            items.push(formatInline(lines[i].replace(/^\s*-\s+/, "")));
            i++;
          }
          html += "
      " + items.map(it => `
    • ${it}
      • `).join("") + "
    ";
          continue;
        }
        if (/^\s*\d+\.\s+/.test(line)) {
          const items = [];
          while (i < lines.length && /^\s*\d+\.\s+/.test(lines[i])) {
            items.push(formatInline(lines[i].replace(/^\s*\d+\.\s+/, "")));
            i++;
          }
          html += "
      " + items.map(it => `
    1. ${it}
      2. `).join("") + "
    ";
          continue;
        }
        if (!line.trim()) {
          i++;
          continue;
        }
        const pLines = [];
        while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() && !lines[i].startsWith("#") && !lines[i].startsWith("```") && !lines[i].startsWith(">") && !lines[i].trim().startsWith("|") && !/^---+$/.test(lines[i].trim()) && !/^\s*(-|\d+\.)\s+/.test(lines[i])) {
          pLines.push(formatInline(lines[i]));
          i++;
        }
        html += `
    ${pLines.join(" ")}
    `;
      }
      return html;
    }

    window.copyCode = function(btn) {
      const pre = btn.closest(".code-wrapper").querySelector("pre");
      const raw = decodeURIComponent(pre.getAttribute("data-raw"));
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(raw);
      const old = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = UI_STRINGS.copied_label;
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = old; }, 1400);
    };

    function renderSidebar() {
      const nav = document.getElementById("navList");
      nav.innerHTML = CHAPTERS.map((ch, idx) => `
        
  • 
          
        
    • 
      `).join("");
    }

    window.selectChapter = function(idx) {
      currentIdx = idx;
      const ch = CHAPTERS[idx];
      location.hash = ch.slug;
      renderSidebar();
      let pagerHtml = '
    ';
      if (idx > 0) {
        pagerHtml += ``;
      } else {
        pagerHtml += '
    ';
      }
      if (idx + 1 < CHAPTERS.length) {
        pagerHtml += ``;
      }
      pagerHtml += '
    ';
      document.getElementById("chapterContent").innerHTML = renderMarkdown(ch.markdown) + pagerHtml;
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    };

    document.getElementById("searchInput").addEventListener("input", (e) => {
      const q = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (q.length < 2) {
        selectChapter(currentIdx);
        return;
      }
      const hits = [];
      CHAPTERS.forEach((ch, idx) => {
        const lines = ch.markdown.split("\n");
        for (const l of lines) {
          if (l.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
            hits.push({ idx, title: ch.title, snippet: l.replace(/^[#>*-]+\s*/, "").slice(0, 140) });
            break;
          }
        }
      });
      const box = hits.length
        ? `
    ${escapeHtml(UI_STRINGS.search_hits_label)} "${escapeHtml(q)}" (${hits.length}):` +
          hits.map(h => `
    ${escapeHtml(h.title)}
    ${escapeHtml(h.snippet)}
    `).join("") +
          `
    `
        : `
    ${escapeHtml(UI_STRINGS.search_empty_label)} "${escapeHtml(q)}".
    `;
      document.getElementById("chapterContent").innerHTML = box + renderMarkdown(CHAPTERS[currentIdx].markdown);
    });

    document.getElementById("themeBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const root = document.documentElement;
      root.setAttribute("data-theme", root.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
    });

    const initialSlug = location.hash.replace(/^#/, "");
    const foundIdx = CHAPTERS.findIndex(c => c.slug === initialSlug);
    selectChapter(foundIdx >= 0 ? foundIdx : 0);
